name: Dataverse table relationships
short_description: Dataverse table relationships connect tables through lookup columns as one-to-many or many-to-many relationships, with configurable relationship behavior (such as parental, referential or restrict) that decides what happens to related rows when a parent row is deleted or reassigned.
